stances.summary: German economic vulnerability to infrastructure bottlenecks poses geopolitical risk
stances.quote: The Straits of Hormuz, you say. ... oh no! Europe's #1 economy is at the mercy of the Straits of Kaub a narrowing of the river Rhine channel where robber barons once held sway.

stances.summary: Climate change and infrastructure neglect threaten German economic growth
stances.quote: Today, climate change and the endless deferral of German infrastructure policy has turned the Kaub passage of the Rhine it into a bottleneck that threatens to throttle what little growth Germany can muster.

stances.summary: Critiques lump of consumption fallacy in trade analysis
stances.quote: Love this formulation. There really is a "lump of consumption" fallacy at work here @teortaxesTex

stances.summary: Questions validity of China Squeeze thesis by Subramanian and co-authors
stances.quote: So the entire "China squeeze" argument, at least as articulated so far by Subramanian and co-authors seems to rest on very fragile foundations.

stances.summary: Critiques 'China Squeeze' argument as resting on fragile counterfactual foundations
stances.quote:
"China Squeeze" - the politics of development counterfactuals. 
China Shock 1.0: happened in the 2000s.
China Shock 2.0: warning of what may happen next.
China Squeeze: what could allegedly have happened if it were not for China's development.

stances.summary: Historical parallels suggest current crisis echoes early 20th century instability
stances.quote: How history ended in Davos ... on, or about September, 1907. Thomas Mann's classic Zauberberg (Magic Mountain) is one of the novels of the moment. @martinwolf_ @delong have both invoked it as a milestone. It has been my June-July reading.

Talk of 1.0 and 2.0 suggests too much continuity btw the early 2000s and today.

stances.summary: Climate crisis will cause severe socio-economic disruption globally
stances.quote: As raging storms or as smothering heat lockdown, the crisis of global heating is going to manifest in many different ways around the globe. As Europe is experiencing this summer, the socio-economic impact will be large.

stances.summary: Global South will suffer disproportionately from climate impacts
stances.quote: One thing we know for sure, is that though the losses in the Global North will be huge, the impact will be most painful in the Global South.
